# Clip 1.3.13
Clip 1.3.13 makes fullscreen Live Share audio exclusions clear and easy to control.
## Live Share audio
- Show **Exclude App Audio** as a full-size settings row with its current value aligned on the right. - Display `None`, the selected application name, or the number of excluded apps directly in the popover. - Keep the native application picker and live audio-exclusion behavior.
## Requirements
Clip requires macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon. This build uses the same stable Apple Development identity as previous updater releases.
